title: Kinetic of appearance of C3 staining, CD11b and C5AR1 gene expression.
caption: a Representative images of C3b (pink) immunofluorescence on snap-frozen mouse kidneys 0, 1, 3, 12, 24 h and 7 days after injection by glycerol, original magnification 20. b Differential expression of Itgam (CD11b, component of the complement Receptor 3) and c C5aR1 (C5a Receptor 1) by QuantiGene in snap-frozen kidney of C57Bl6 WT mice at 0, 1, 3, 12, 24 h and 7 days after injection by glycerol. Presented results are from one experiment with 5 mice at time 0, 4 mice at 1 h, 3 h, 12 hours and 24 h each, and 3 mice at day 7.
